description_en: Retrieves the information about a template based on the template ID. Advanced templates require a longer parsing time. When the template type is advanced, it can be used once the Status is Available
description_zh: 根据模板ID获取模板信息。高级模板有解析过长，当类型为高级模板时，Status为Available时即可使用
name: GetTemplate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the media assets associated with the template. Valid values:
1: Returns the associated media assets.
0: Does not return the associated media assets.
Default value: 0. This parameter is valid only for standard templates
parameters.help_zh: 相关媒体ID标记，默认值0，当值为1时返回模板关联素材，仅普通模板有效
parameters.name: related_mediaid_flag

ClipsParam.description_en:
The ClipsParam parameter template for submitting a synthesis task. You can replace mediaId and text with actual parameters to submit the synthesis task. For usage methods, refer to:

[Create and use standard templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445399.html）
[Create and use advanced templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）
ClipsParam.description_zh:
提交合成任务的ClipsParam参数模板，可把mediaId和text换成真实的参数来提交合成任务。使用方式参考：

[普通模版创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445399.html）
[高级模板创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）

Config.description_en:
The template configuration.
For standard template configuration, refer to [Timeline template configuration details]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456193.html）.
For advanced template configuration, refer to [Create advanced templates]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）.
For one-click video production template configuration, refer to [One-click video production template configuration parameter description]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878274.html）
Config.description_zh:
模板配置
普通模板配置，参考[Timeline模板配置详解]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456193.html）
高级模板配置，参考[创建高级模板]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）
一键成片模版配置，参考[一键成片模版配置参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878274.html）

PreviewMediaStatus.description_en:
The preview media asset status. Valid values:
Init (initial status: the source file is not ready)
Preparing (the source file is being prepared, such as being uploaded or undergoing editing and synthesis)
PrepareFail (the source file preparation failed, such as a failure to obtain the source file information)
Normal (normal: the source file is ready)
PreviewMediaStatus.description_zh:
预览素材状态
Init（初始状态：源文件未就绪）
Preparing（源文件准备中：比如上传中或者剪辑合成中）
PrepareFail（源文件准备失败：比如获取源文件信息失败）
Normal（正常：源文件已就绪）
